findings.span: reduction of Corynebacterium xerosis in 10 minutes
findings.why: A kill-rate on a named bacterium is an anti-bacterial claim in effect (DEC-01 keeps these flagged); it is in-vitro and the footnote says so. Needs legal sign-off.
findings.fix: Remove it, or attach the study file for review.

tone_read: Calm, factual and ingredient-led for Nonapeptide + AHA 6% Underarm Roll-On, with no fear, hype or urgency; the study basis is stated plainly.
language_read: Numbers are quoted as the product page states them with their qualifier; efficacy stays at perception or study level and no unhedged cure or natural framing appears.
